title.zh: 刑事诉讼（保留与过渡条款）条例 2024
title.en: Criminal Procedure (Saving and Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Criminal Procedure (Saving and Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2024 and come into operation on 1 August 2024.

2. Despite section 40 of the Criminal Procedure (Miscellaneous Amendments) Act 2024, section 359 of the Criminal Procedure Code 2010 as in force immediately before 1 August 2024 continues to apply for the payment of compensation by a person convicted of any offence if the person committed the offence before that date.
